title: Redux Thunk
description: Learn async logic with Redux Thunk middleware.

data.text: **Redux Thunk** is middleware that allows you to write action creators that return functions instead of actions. It's the standard way to handle async logic in Redux.

data.title: Thunk
Modern Alternative
data.text: createAsyncThunk from Redux Toolkit is the modern replacement for hand-written thunks.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Thunks return functions instead of actions
data.takeaway: Thunks handle async logic in Redux.
